ei.title: The Role of Order in Effective Teaching
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Teaching reflects what society itself demands; it necessitates that disorder — of students and teachers alike, of mind, behavior, and environment — yield to its opposite. Effective teaching requires that, failing their own self-imposed order, students experience the imposition of some outer order so that inner order may develop. This means in practice, for instance, that the goals of classes and courses be clearly set, that they be explained and justified, that the manner of achieving them be clear, that the presentation of materials conducive to reaching them be appropriate, and that all activities be directed somehow to their attainment. It means, too, that students take up their own obligation to maintain the conditions under which learning occurs: quiet in their classrooms, respect for and courtesy toward others, civility of language and behavior, and the like. Above all, it implies structured industry — study and activity that are oriented toward a goal and pursued with perseverance and method. That is, good teaching requires that teachers and students subject themselves to external and internal control so that learning can take place.

questions.passage: Teaching reflects what society itself demands; it necessitates that (A)[disorder / harmony] — of students and teachers alike, of mind, behavior, and environment — yield to its opposite. Effective teaching requires that, failing their own self-imposed order, students experience the imposition of some (B)[outer / (C)[inner / outer]] order so that inner order may develop. This means in practice, for instance, that the goals of classes and courses be clearly set, that they be explained and justified, that the manner of achieving them be clear, that the presentation of materials conducive to reaching them be appropriate, and that all activities be directed somehow to their attainment. It means, too, that students take up their own obligation to maintain the conditions under which learning occurs: quiet in their classrooms, respect for and courtesy toward others, civility of language and behavior, and the like. Above all, it implies structured industry — study and activity that are oriented toward a goal and pursued with perseverance and method. That is, good teaching requires that teachers and students subject themselves to external and internal control so that learning can take place.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ disorder - outer - inner = 원문과 일치
❌ ② harmony: 가르침이 극복해야 할 대상을 '조화'라 하면 원문 흐름과 정반대
❌ ① inner(내부의): 학생이 먼저 경험하는 것은 '외부의(outer) 질서'라는 원문과 모순
❌ ④ outer(외부의): 궁극적으로 발달하는 것은 '내적(inner) 질서'라는 원문과 반대
det.tip: outer order(외부 질서)를 경험해야 inner order(내적 질서)가 발달한다는 본문의 핵심 대비 구조를 기억하자.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① harmful: 목표 도달에 '해로운' 자료라 하면 효과적 수업 서술과 정반대
✅ ② conducive - appropriate - attainment = 원문과 일치
❌ ③ irrelevant(무관한): 자료 제시가 '적절해야' 한다는 원문과 모순
❌ ④ failure(실패): 모든 활동이 목표 '달성'을 향해야 한다는 원문과 반대
det.tip: conducive to reaching goals(목표 도달에 도움이 되는), directed to attainment(달성을 향해 이루어지는)가 핵심 구문이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① privilege(특권): 학생이 져야 할 것은 '특권'이 아니라 '의무'이므로 원문과 반대
❌ ② rudeness(무례함): 유지해야 할 것은 '예의'이므로 원문과 정반대
✅ ③ obligation - civility - perseverance = 원문과 일치
❌ ④ laziness(게으름): 체계적 면학은 '인내'로 추구된다는 원문과 모순

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ④ outer → inner: 외부 질서를 통해 결국 발달해야 할 것은 '내적(inner)' 질서이므로 'outer'는 반복 사용되어 부적절
det.tip: outer order → inner order로 이어지는 방향성이 본문의 핵심이다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① conducive: 'materials ___ to reaching them' 자리에서 '목표 도달에 도움이 되는' 자료라는 뜻이 된다. 전치사 'to'와 짝을 이루는 형용사이다.
❌ ② appropriate(적절한): 뒤 문장에서 'presentation'을 수식하는 단어로 이미 쓰이고, 'to reaching'과 결합하지 않음
❌ ③ oriented(지향된): 뒤 단락에서 'oriented toward a goal'로 쓰이며 자리와 맞지 않음
❌ ④ structured(체계적인): 학습 태도를 수식하는 단어로 쓰이며 자료를 수식하지 않음
det.tip: be conducive to V-ing(~하는 데 도움이 되다)는 전치사 to + 동명사 구조가 포인트다.

(A) Good teaching requires that teachers and students subject themselves to external and internal control so that learning can take place.
(B) English grammar is my favorite subject, and I spend hours reviewing it every week.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 subject의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ③ (A)에서 '주제'는 'subject themselves to'라는 재귀 구조와 맞지 않음
❌ ② (A) '과목'은 동사 자리와 문맥에 부합하지 않음
✅ ① (A) 통제에 스스로를 '복종시키다' / (B) 영문법이 좋아하는 '과목'이라는 의미
❌ ④ (B) '주제'는 grammar is my favorite subject에서 '과목'이 더 자연스러움
det.tip: subject oneself to ~(~에 스스로를 복종시키다)는 동사 용법이고, favorite subject는 '좋아하는 과목'이라는 명사 용법이다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the act of making something necessary or unavoidable"

det.analysis:
✅ ④ necessitate: '어떤 것을 필수적이거나 피할 수 없게 만드는 행위'를 뜻한다
❌ ① reflect(반영하다): 의미 방향이 다름
❌ ② yield(양보하다): 반대 방향의 의미
❌ ③ maintain(유지하다): 무관한 의미
det.tip: necessitate = make necessary. 본문에서는 'it necessitates that ~'으로 사용된다.

questions.passage: Effective teaching requires that, failing their own self-imposed order, students experience the __________ (impose) of some outer order so that inner order may develop.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 정관사 'the' 뒤에는 명사 형태가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: 정관사 'the' 뒤이자 전치사 'of'의 수식을 받는 자리이므로 동사 'impose'를 명사형 'imposition'으로 바꿔야 한다. 'the imposition of some outer order'는 '어떤 외부 질서의 부과'라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: 동사 impose → 명사 imposition. '-tion' 접미사가 붙어 명사형이 된다.

questions.passage: Above all, it implies structured industry — study and activity that are __________ (orient) toward a goal and pursued with perseverance and method.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: be동사 뒤에는 상태를 나타내는 과거분사(수동 형용사) 형태가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: 'are' 뒤에는 형용사/분사 보어가 와야 하며, 면학 활동이 목표를 향해 '지향된' 상태라는 수동 의미이므로 과거분사 'oriented'로 바꾼다.
det.tip: be oriented toward ~(~을 향해 지향된)는 수동형 관용 표현이다.

questions.passage: Teaching reflects what society itself demands; it necessitates that disorder — of students and teachers alike, of mind, behavior, and environment — yield to its opposite. Effective teaching requires that, failing their own __________, students experience the imposition of some outer order so that inner order may develop. This means in practice, for instance, that the goals of classes and courses be clearly set, that they be explained and justified, that the manner of achieving them be clear, that the presentation of materials conducive to reaching them be appropriate, and that all activities be directed somehow to their attainment. It means, too, that students take up their own obligation to maintain the conditions under which learning occurs: quiet in their classrooms, respect for and courtesy toward others, civility of language and behavior, and the like. Above all, it implies structured industry — study and activity that are oriented toward a goal and pursued with perseverance and method. That is, good teaching requires that teachers and students subject themselves to external and internal control so that learning can take place.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① self-imposed order: 이 질서가 '실패했을 때' 학생이 외부 질서를 경험해야 한다는 맥락이므로 '스스로 부과한 질서'가 정답이다.
❌ ② structured industry(체계적 면학): 본문 후반의 결론 개념이며 '실패'와 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ outer order(외부 질서): 오히려 자기 질서가 실패했을 때 '경험하는 대상'이므로 자리 부적절
❌ ④ civility of language(언행의 예의): 학습 공동체 조건의 하나일 뿐, 'failing'의 대상이 아님
det.tip: failing their own self-imposed order(스스로 부과한 질서가 실패했을 때)는 본문 논리의 출발점이다.

questions.passage: Teaching reflects what society itself demands; it necessitates that disorder — of students and teachers alike, of mind, behavior, and environment — yield to its opposite. Effective teaching requires that, failing their own self-imposed order, students experience the imposition of some outer order so that inner order may develop. This means in practice, for instance, that the goals of classes and courses be clearly set, that they be explained and justified, that the manner of achieving them be clear, that the presentation of materials conducive to reaching them be appropriate, and that all activities be directed somehow to their attainment. It means, too, that students take up their own obligation to maintain the conditions under which learning occurs: quiet in their classrooms, respect for and courtesy toward others, civility of language and behavior, and the like. Above all, it implies structured industry — study and activity that are oriented toward a goal and __________. That is, good teaching requires that teachers and students subject themselves to external and internal control so that learning can take place.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② pursued with perseverance and method: '체계적 면학'을 정의하는 둘째 수식어 자리. 'oriented toward a goal'과 'and'로 병렬되어야 하므로 과거분사 구문인 ②만 형태상·의미상 부합한다.
❌ ① directed somehow to their attainment: 본문의 다른 문장에 이미 쓰인 표현이며 '체계적 면학' 정의와 다름
❌ ③ conducive to reaching them: 자료의 속성을 나타내는 표현이며 학습 태도 자리와 부적절
❌ ④ subject themselves to external and internal control: 동사구로 주어가 필요해 문법상 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않음
det.tip: structured industry = study and activity (1) oriented toward a goal + (2) pursued with perseverance and method. 두 수식어의 병렬 구조를 파악해야 한다.

ch: subject themselves to external and internal control
